purpose: Teach: 群衆/語源/裏切っ/献血/くくっ/苑/龍/埋もれ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、群衆向けイベントを企画しろ
lines.en: Plan a crowd-facing event for the company.
lines.style: Direct, commanding tone. Clipped pacing on the main instruction. Expectation of immediate comprehension and action. No room for questions.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。ブランド名の語源を社内、共有いたします
lines.en: Yes. I'll share the brand's etymological background with the team.
lines.style: Respectful affirmation. Steady, methodical delivery. Each phrase lands with quiet competence. Professional and slightly formal.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社の信頼を裏切った供給先とは取引停止だ
lines.en: We're cutting ties with any supplier who's betrayed our trust.
lines.style: Firm decision, no negotiation. Sharp attack on the main clause. Measured but unyielding. The tone of someone protecting something that matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内で献血キャンペーンを始めました
lines.en: Yes. We've already started a blood donation campaign here at the office.
lines.style: Eager to report progress. Warm undertone beneath the formality. Slight lift at 'already started' — showing initiative. Responsive and engaged.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員をくくった枠組みでなく自由を与えろ
lines.en: Don't box your employees in with rigid frameworks. Give them freedom.
lines.style: Conviction with a touch of exasperation. Weight on 'freedom.' Not lecturing, but pushing back against tired thinking. Measured but pointed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新店舗を社苑のような癒しの空間に設計します
lines.en: Understood. We'll design the new store as a healing space — like a sanctuary.
lines.style: Confirming with quiet vision. Soft, thoughtful delivery on 'healing space.' Not rushed. Shows he's listening and picturing it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 龍のロゴで力強さを表現しろ
lines.en: Use the dragon logo to convey strength and power.
lines.style: Clear directive. Sharp emphasis on 'dragon' and 'strength.' Confident in the image. Expects the symbolism to land immediately.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。倉庫に埋もれた古い商品を、整理いたします
lines.en: Yes. I'll organize and clear out the old stock that's been buried in the warehouse.
lines.style: Final confirmation, efficient and closing. Slightly faster pace — wrapping up the conversation. Respectful but ready to move to action.
